description: Rochester, NY – Today, the Northeast Regional Council of Carpenters (NRCC) endorsed Joe Morelle for the 25th Congressional District. One of the largest trade unions on the East Coast, the NRCC represents thousands of men and women and equips them with the skills necessary to succeed in today’s construction industry.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY JOE MORELLE FOR CONGRESS bottom of page
title: Carpenters Endorse Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
